test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of March 2021, with a throw of 88.07 m, javelin star Neeraj Chopra set a national record in the third Indian Grand Prix in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patiala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Asian Games and Commonwealth Games gold medallist Neeraj Chopra threw an attempt of 88.07m to create a new national record in the javelin throw event at the Indian Grand Prix 3 at the **National Institute of Sports (NIS), Patiala** .
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's** national record javelin throw matched or surpassed only 3% times since 1986.
 
• Ne
